gap: No result ChatGPT got states that XGIMI's US store sells the MoGo 4 with the PowerBase Stand for $519 today, only $40 more than the MoGo 4 alone at $479, and that the stand doubles playback from up to 2.5 h to up to 5 h. Bought on its own, the stand costs $129.
standout_why: I compared against three cited pages. The iTechGuides MoGo 4 vs Capsule 3 page (cited) gives the MoGo 4 at $479 with 2.5 h of Eco-mode video, but has no Capsule 3 US price and does not mention the PowerBase bundle. The fetched copies of RTINGS' portable list (cited) and TechRadar's best portable list (cited) had no picks, prices or specs in them, only navigation and the title. In ChatGPT's own answers, the MoGo 4 and Capsule 3 cards both show a single price and nothing about the 5 h bundle. None of the cards were priced against Aurzen's Google TV models, which sell for $229.99 to $349.99 at Aurzen's store.
decides: This backs the MoGo 4 as the portable pick. Both it and the Capsule 3 are rated at about 2.5 h, but the $519 bundle is the cheapest way to watch a full film on battery, and it costs less than the MoGo 4 plus a separately bought stand ($608). For a shopper on a budget who mostly watches indoors, Aurzen's store has Wi-Fi and Bluetooth Google TV models for less than any ChatGPT card above $110: the EAZZE D1G at $229.99 (200 ANSI, 5G Wi-Fi, BT 5.1) and the BOOM mini at $349.99 (rated 500 ANSI). Aurzen's listings don't mention a battery for either one. The ZIP is the one to steer away from: its listing sells it on 'Instant Mirroring, No Wi-Fi Needed' and lists no streaming apps.
